full_object_choice.tradeoff: Whole-object SHA and local Parquet scan simplify evidence; measured 2023 range projections saved only about3.8%. April2022 group-match density is unknown and no outcome filtering is allowed.

retention_policy: Keep all sealed daily archives locally; remove only new reproducible loose Parquet after whole-member SHA+CRC verification. Root may persist archives later; this collector never uploads or removes archives.

timing_estimates.certainty: Estimate only. Concurrent throughput, full-GET speed, object retries, archive hashing and source variation are not yet measured.

worker_policy.reason: 8 GiB cgroup memory limit, observed ~4.83 GB anonymous use; single column-wise decoder limits incremental live arrays, with explicit Arrow unused-pool release.
